issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stonecutter.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Lumber camp level 2: adds the stone mill race and a saw, so it starts to read as a mill; still small and all one brown.
problems: Carlton asked for "a saw mill style instead of this puny thing": it is still a small lean-to shed that is hard to read. Make the saw the centrepiece: a long open mill hall with the saw bench in the middle, a log yard of stacked logs on one side and a plank stack on the other.
The roof is a single slope of one plank colour, flush with the walls: a proper gable or a lean-to with dark eaves and one block of overhang.
Everything is the same brown: add a cobblestone base under the posts and a dark frame against lighter infill.
Level 3 only adds a sapling and leaves over level 2: give it its own feature (a log cart, a second saw, a covered log store).

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stonecutter.
415 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Lumber camp level 2: adds a waterwheel on a stone race, benches and more stock; a proper water-powered saw mill.
problems: Almost everything is brown wood; a cobblestone base under the posts all round would ground it.
Level 3 adds only more stacks and saplings over level 2; a covered log store or a log cart would make it its own.

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stonecutter.
2 block(s) touch nothing that leads down to layer 0 (in game, layer 0 sits on top of the ground, so these hang in the air): (5, 3, 4), (9, 3, 4).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Level 2 adds a waterwheel in a stone race on the left and a log yard of stacked crates and logs on the right. Clearly a working mill and clearly more than L1.
problems: The two hanging lanterns inside the shed at (5, 3, 4) and (9, 3, 4) have nothing above them (air up to the roof): in game they drop off. Hang them on a chain from the roof beam or put them on the posts
The waterwheel reads as a dark block from most angles: open spokes (fences or trapdoors) between the paddles would make it read as a wheel
Water in the race comes from the decoration step (fine)
